name: Loan Eligibility - B Ingestion and Deterministic Matching

parameters.query: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO processed_events (event_id, event_type, payload) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING event_id) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS is_new, $1 AS event_id, $2 AS event_type, $4::uuid AS upload_batch_id;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'duplicate', event_type: 'users.ingestion.completed', event_id: $json.event_id, upload_batch_id: $json.upload_batch_id, metrics: { evaluated: 0, stored: 0 } }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT id, upload_batch_id, user_id, name, email, monthly_income, credit_score, employment_status, age FROM users WHERE upload_batch_id = $1 ORDER BY source_row_number;
SELECT id, product_id, name, criteria, active FROM loan_products WHERE active = true ORDER BY product_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_uuid, u.upload_batch_id, u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score, u.employment_status, u.age, p.id AS loan_product_uuid, p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.criteria, true AS sql_candidate FROM users u CROSS JOIN loan_products p WHERE u.upload_batch_id = $1 AND p.active = true AND (p.criteria->>'min_monthly_income' IS NULL OR u.monthly_income >= (p.criteria->>'min_monthly_income')::numeric) AND (p.criteria->>'max_monthly_income' IS NULL OR u.monthly_income <= (p.criteria->>'max_monthly_income')::numeric) AND (p.criteria->>'min_credit_score' IS NULL OR u.credit_score >= (p.criteria->>'min_credit_score')::integer) AND (p.criteria->>'max_credit_score' IS NULL OR u.credit_score <= (p.criteria->>'max_credit_score')::integer) AND (p.criteria->>'min_age' IS NULL OR u.age >= (p.criteria->>'min_age')::integer) AND (p.criteria->>'max_age' IS NULL OR u.age <= (p.criteria->>'max_age')::integer) AND (p.criteria->>'employment_status' IS NULL OR lower(u.employment_status) = lower(p.criteria->>'employment_status') OR p.criteria->'employment_status' ? lower(u.employment_status));

={{ $json.is_summary ? 'SELECT 0 AS stored' : 'INSERT INTO matches (upload_batch_id, user_id, loan_product_id, decision, evaluated_criteria, unknown_criteria, reasons) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (upload_batch_id, user_id, loan_product_id) DO UPDATE SET decision = EXCLUDED.decision, evaluated_criteria = EXCLUDED.evaluated_criteria, unknown_criteria = EXCLUDED.unknown_criteria, reasons = EXCLUDED.reasons RETURNING upload_batch_id, user_id, loan_product_id;' }}
